"""Handed-off typed import/authoring/save/reopen and ONE 1200x1500/64 sample true-pass render job."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,sys,time
from PIL import Image
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/'artifacts'
sys.path.insert(0,'EVIDENCE_ROOT/chengdu-ecosystem-motion-v1');import run_motion
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--broker',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--first-id',type=int,required=True);p.add_argument('--host-released',action='store_true');a=p.parse_args();assert a.host_released
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert not OUT.exists() and not (ROOT/'submission.json').exists() and not (ROOT/'floor-adjustment.json').exists()
freeze=json.loads((ROOT/'source-freeze.json').read_text())
for name,digest in freeze.items():assert sha(ROOT/name)==digest
source=ROOT.parent/'houdini-blender-lighting/artifacts/cross-dcc-lighting.blend'
assert sha(source)=='cd8654110f769605490ab00de09d8ed97420a0a13ef5996fb26b025bb0ea02cd'
budget=run_motion.resource_check();run_motion.BROKER=a.broker;i=a.first_id
skills=['blender-scene','blender-interchange','blender-data-geometry','blender-materials','blender-camera','blender-lighting','blender-scripting','blender-render']
req=a.broker/'requests'/f'{i}.json';res=a.broker/'responses'/f'{i}.json';assert not req.exists() and not res.exists()
partial=req.with_suffix('.partial');partial.write_text(json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':i,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'load_skill','arguments':{'skill_names':skills}}}));partial.replace(req)
deadline=time.monotonic()+120
while not res.exists():
 if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Uncertain preflight; do not retry')
 time.sleep(.25)
raw=json.loads(res.read_text());result=json.loads(raw['body'])['result'];data=result.get('structuredContent')
if data is None:data=json.loads(next(c['text'] for c in result['content'] if c.get('type')=='text'))
assert raw['status']==200 and not result.get('isError') and data.get('loaded') and not data.get('partial')
registered=set(data['registered_tools']);required={'blender_interchange__import_file','blender_data_geometry__create_mesh_from_data','blender_materials__create_material','blender_materials__assign_material','blender_camera__create_camera','blender_lighting__create_light','blender_lighting__set_world_background','blender_render__start_render_job','blender_scene__save_scene','blender_scripting__execute_script_file','blender_scene__new_scene','blender_scene__open_scene','blender_render__set_render_settings','blender_render__set_render_denoise','blender_render__get_render_job','blender_render__set_view_layer_passes'};assert required<=registered,required-registered
(ROOT/'preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps({'request_id':i,'response_sha256':sha(res),'actual_tools':data.get('tools'),'schema_boundary':'Registered names checked; generic schemas do not prove field validation'},indent=2));i+=1
(ROOT/'submission.json').write_text(json.dumps({'budget':budget,'source_hashes':freeze,'saved_pilot_sha256':sha(source),'first_mutation_id':i,'scope':'one final cross-DCC lighting image, support-floor extension only'},indent=2))
def call(name,args):
 global i
 result=run_motion.call(i,name,args);print(i,name,flush=True);i+=1;return result
call('blender_scene__open_scene',{'filepath':str(source)})
call('blender_render__set_render_settings',{'engine':'CYCLES','resolution_x':1200,'resolution_y':1500,'resolution_percentage':100,'fps':24,'samples':64,'file_format':'OPEN_EXR_MULTILAYER'})
call('blender_render__set_render_denoise',{'enabled':False,'denoiser':'OPENIMAGEDENOISE','use_gpu':False})
call('blender_render__set_view_layer_passes',{'enable':['denoising'],'view_layer_name':'ViewLayer'})
call('blender_scripting__execute_script_file',{'filepath':str(ROOT/'prepare_final.py')})
call('blender_scripting__execute_script_file',{'filepath':str(ROOT/'verify_final.py')})
OUT.mkdir();blend=OUT/'cross-dcc-lighting-final.blend'
call('blender_scene__save_scene',{'filepath':str(blend)})
blend_sha=sha(blend)
(ROOT/'saved-source.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sha256':blend_sha,'bytes':blend.stat().st_size,'source_hashes':freeze},indent=2))
call('blender_scene__new_scene',{});call('blender_scene__open_scene',{'filepath':str(blend)})
verified=call('blender_scripting__execute_script_file',{'filepath':str(ROOT/'verify_final.py')});assert sha(blend)==blend_sha
(ROOT/'reopen-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(verified,indent=2))
run_motion.resource_check();assert not (OUT/'frames').exists()
job=call('blender_render__start_render_job',{'output_pattern':str(OUT/'frames/frame_####'),'start_frame':1,'end_frame':1,'step':1,'resume_missing':False,'device':'CPU','save_before_render':False,'output_format':'OPEN_EXR_MULTILAYER','factory_startup':True})
(ROOT/'render-submission.json').write_text(json.dumps(job,indent=2));job_id=job['context']['job_id']
for _ in range(120):
 time.sleep(5);status=call('blender_render__get_render_job',{'job_id':job_id})
 if status['context']['status'] in ('completed','failed','cancelled'):
  (ROOT/'terminal.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,indent=2));assert status['context']['status']=='completed',status;break
else:raise TimeoutError('Job still uncertain; retain job_id and monitor, never resubmit')
image=OUT/'frames/frame_0001.exr';assert image.is_file() and image.stat().st_size>0
(ROOT/'output-index.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sha256':sha(image),'bytes':image.stat().st_size,'source_blend_sha256':blend_sha,'full_decode':'pending native mature decoder; file existence is NOT acceptance','visual_review':'pending'},indent=2))
print(str(image))
